record.bible_text: My breath<WH07307> is corrupt<WH02254><WTH8795>, my days<WH03117> are extinct<WH02193><WTH8738>, the graves<WH06913> <FI>are ready<Fi> for me. <RF>breath...: or, spirit is spent<Rf>
